[[File:Dan Burns InQuest 17 (1996).jpg|thumb|right|260px|Burns at his Decipher workstation in 1996. Photo: InQuest.<ref name="iq17">Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60; photograph on p. 60. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n61/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref>]]
'''Dan Burns''' was Decipher's creative director and the art director of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkartists">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/artists/index.html Jedi Knights: Artists], decipher.com (2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001207231800/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/artists/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

The credits page of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet (1995) thanks Dan Burns "for once again creating the impossible against improbable odds".<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref>
